answer: A concrete Sybil defense maps the attestation graph and slashes collusion rings. Accounts that keep grading each other form a dense timber of mutual edges and are collapsed into one actor. When that ring is exposed, every bonded stake inside it is burned together, so a factory of sockpuppets cannot climb to a zenith of extra votes. Painting many names with the same pigment of reciprocal grades therefore costs the attacker the whole locked stack, not a single cheap key.
